race.comment: BLUE WILLOW (7) can break through here. She was well supported last start here over 1800m but just got too far back behind the progressive Komito who sat close to a fast pace and kept kicking. BLUE WILLOW charged into second and although she'll be back again, she can round these up. MISS CASTELVECCHIO (5) was a strong winner in easier company at Geelong second-up and looks set to go on with it this time in dropping nicely in the weights. TEMPRANILLO (4) presents third-up and ready to fire. Two runs back have been good and she gets to her ideal trip now, go close. ELEANOR DUMONT (2) struggled last time in a rare miss. Her form prior was rock solid and she can bounce back. ZESHADOW (6) next best.
